title: Compute the Interactions, Not the Attributes: What a Fact Layer Must Supply in the Chinese Sexagenary System
abstract: arXiv:2611.13597v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language-model systems in rule-governed domains often pair the model with a deterministic fact layer, but which facts that layer should supply is rarely measured. We measure it in the Chinese sexagenary system underlying BaZi chart analysis, where every fact has one table-checkable value: 682 items over twelve fact categories and 160 transit--natal collision items, posed closed-book, with the reference table, and with computed facts at increasing levels. In eleven open-weight models answering directly, errors concentrate where attributes must be combined: none gets more than 4\% of sexagenary days or 1\% of collisions right. Static attributes have no consistent effect, and the complete relation list leaves most direct-answering models near zero although it contains the answer. translated_title: 计算交互，而非属性：中国六十甲子系统中事实层必须提供什么
translated_abstract: 在受规则支配的领域中，语言模型系统通常将模型与一个确定性的事实层配对使用，但该事实层究竟应提供哪些事实却鲜有量化衡量。我们在八字排盘分析所依据的中国六十甲子系统中对此进行了测量，其中每个事实都有一个可通过查表核验的唯一值：包括十二个事实类别下的682个题目，以及160个流年—本命冲撞题目；测试分别在闭卷、提供参考表、以及提供递增级别计算事实的条件下进行。在十一个开源权重模型直接作答时，错误集中在必须组合属性之处：没有任何模型在六十甲子日上答对超过4%，在冲撞题目上答对超过1%。静态属性没有一致效果，而完整的关系列表虽然包含答案，却仍使大多数直接作答的模型接近零分。一个按查询过滤的事实层（探索性方案）将Qwen3-8B与Qwen3-32B提升至78–92%，并将另外四个模型提升至96–100%。三个专有推理模型可计算68-……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究以八字六十甲子系统构建可查表事实基准，发现开源语言模型在需要组合属性的交互型事实上几乎全部失败，而提供按查询过滤、已计算好的交互事实可将准确率提升至96–100%，说明事实层应当“计算交互”而非罗列静态属性。
en_tdlr: Open-weight LLMs fail almost entirely on facts requiring attribute combination in the Chinese sexagenary system, while a query-filtered fact layer that supplies computed interactions raises accuracy to 96–100%, showing the fact layer must compute interactions rather than list attributes.
